query:
UPDATE trees SET
                tree_cluster_id = $2,
                planting_year = $3,
                species = $4,
                number = $5,
                description = $6,
                watering_status = $7,
                last_watered = $8,
                latitude = $9,
                longitude = $10,
                geometry = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($10, $9), 4326),
                provider = $11,
                additional_informations = $12,
                organization_id = $13
            WHERE id = $1
